_comment: THE VERB LIST — Puzzle Level Playbook §3, codified from the SHIPPED game.
These verbs already exist; this file documents them so mission graphs
(assets/dungeons.json) can be validated against them. The playbook's
8-verb cap governs NEW verbs: none may be added here without a design
pass over every existing room. What keeps the per-region vocabulary
inside the cap is the grant schedule — a region is played with only the
verbs earned before it, so no region ever asks for more than ~6.
Each verb lists its affordances (playbook: a verb needs >=3 or it is a
key, not a verb). Affordances marked (new) ship with the puzzle rebuild.
Verbs are PERMANENT once granted — never taken away (L-verbs rule).

carry.trade: carrying disables the special (Wild Arms rule)

affordances: fill dry basins (new — chains with frost_breath)

producer_consumer_pairs.consume: frost_breath (freeze it into a standable block)
carry (bear the light through the dark)
wind carries a floating seed/ember down the lane

cap_note: 8-verb cap applies to additions. Grant schedule keeps any single region's active set at 4-6.
